content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for OUAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for OUAT Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the OUAT Guest Faculty posts is scheduled for 24th September 2026 and 25th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on these dates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Guest Faculty positions at OUAT?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Master's Degree in the respective subject from a recognized University with at least 55% marks or an equivalent CGPA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty positions is 64 years, as of 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty posts at OUAT?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions announced by OUAT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty at OUAT?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 1200/- per class, with a maximum monthly earning capped at Rs. 60,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the OUAT Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for OUAT Guest Faculty posts going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Odisha University of Agriculture and Technology (OUAT) campus in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation for SC/ST candidates. The maximum age limit is 64 years for all.
